versions.name: Weather
versions.description: Read clouds, fronts and pressure systems well enough to tell what is coming, build a rain gauge or anemometer and keep a daily log, and teach others the rules for lightning, flash floods and tornadoes.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
